short_name: FAR 52.204-21 Basic Safeguarding of Covered Contractor Information Systems
summary: 15 basic safeguarding requirements for contractor systems that process, store or transmit Federal Contract Information (FCI).
applies_to: Federal contractors and subcontractors with FCI on their information systems.
size_thresholds: No size exemption; clause excluded only for COTS item acquisitions. For DoD contracts, CMMC Level 1 (Self) verifies these 15 requirements.
status: In effect. Note: FAR is being rewritten under the 'Revolutionary FAR Overhaul' (FAR proposed rules 2026); clause numbering may change.

short_name: FAR 52.204-25 Section 889 prohibition (covered telecom/video surveillance equipment)
summary: Prohibits providing or using covered telecommunications/video surveillance equipment or services (e.g., Huawei, ZTE, Hytera, Hikvision, Dahua) and requires reporting when identified.
applies_to: Federal contractors, including those installing security cameras, networks and building systems.

short_name: DFARS 252.204-7012 Safeguarding Covered Defense Information and Cyber Incident Reporting
summary: Requires 'adequate security' including NIST SP 800-171 on systems with covered defense information (CDI), FedRAMP Moderate-equivalent cloud, 72-hour incident reporting, malware submission, 90-day image preservation, and flowdown.
applies_to: DoD contractors and subcontractors whose performance involves CDI or operationally critical support.
size_thresholds: No small-business exemption; flowdown required to subcontracts involving CDI/operationally critical support, including commercial products/services.

short_name: CMMC Program rule (32 CFR Part 170) + DFARS CMMC acquisition rule (DFARS 252.204-7021)
summary: Requires contractors to hold a current CMMC status (Level 1 Self; Level 2 Self or C3PAO against 110 NIST SP 800-171 R2 requirements; Level 3 DIBCAC adding 24 NIST SP 800-172 requirements) in SPRS, with annual affirmations, as a condition of award.
applies_to: DoD contractors/subcontractors that process, store or transmit FCI or CUI on contractor information systems.
size_thresholds: No size exemption. Applies to solicitations/contracts above the micro-purchase threshold, except those exclusively for COTS items (32 CFR 170.3(c)). Level set by DoD per contract (FCI -> L1; CUI -> L2; high-priority CUI -> L3). Conditional status valid 180 days; final L1 1 year, L2/L3 3 years.
status: 32 CFR 170 effective Dec. 16, 2024. DFARS rule effective Nov. 10, 2025 = Phase 1 start (L1/L2 Self). Phase 2 begins Nov. 10, 2026 (L2 C3PAO as condition of award); Phase 3 Nov. 10, 2027 (L2 C3PAO for options; L3); Phase 4 full implementation Nov. 10, 2028 (32 CFR 170.3(e)).
